High School: Fordham Prep2018-19 Season (Senior) All-ACC ... PING All-East Region ... played in 12 events with a stroke average of 70.56 ... had three victories (most in a season by a Deac since 2004) and finished his career with five wins (T-4th most in Wake Forest history) ... shot a 12-under 204 to win the General Hackler Invitational ... had a career-best 19-under 197 to win the Augusta Haskins Award Invitational ... shot 8-under to share medalist honors at the Stitch Intercollegiate ... also had top-10 finishes at Valspar Collegiate and NCAA Myrtle Beach Regional ... ACC Player of the Month (March) ... shot a career-best 63 in the first round of the Augusta Haskins Award Invitational ... won his match in the NCAA quarterfinal vs. Stanford ... finished eight events under par ... had 25 rounds of par or better. 2017-18 Season (Junior) Honorable Mention All-American ... All-ACC ... ACC All-Academic Team ... PING All-East Region ... played in nine events with a stroke average of 70.11 (3rd best in program history) ... had four top-5 finishes (Rod Myers Invitational, Shoal Creek Intercollegiate, 3M Augusta Invitational, Stitch Intercollegiate) ... best finish was T-2nd at Stitch Intercollegiate ... shot a season-best 204 (-12-under) at the Warrior Princeville Makai Invitational ... had 11 rounds in the 60s ... Had a season-best 65 in the final round of the Warrior Princeville Makai Invitational ... 22 of 27 rounds were at par or better. 2016-17 Season (Sophomore) All-ACC ... ACC All-Academic Team ... PING All-East Region ... played in nine events and had a scoring average of 72.81 ... best finish was T-10th at the Rod Myers Invitational ... Shot a season-best 213 (3-under) at the Golf Club of Georgia Collegiate ... Had a season-best 67 during the first round of the Nike Golf Collegiate Invitational ... Had 12 rounds of par or better ... qualified for the U.S. Amateur ... won the 2017 New York Open, becoming the first amateur to ever win the title. 2015-16 Season (Freshman) Played in 13 events and had a scoring average of 72.87 ... Individual champion at the U.S. Collegiate Championship and the Warrior Princeville Makai Invitational, becoming the first Demon Deacon to win twice during the fall season since Bill Haas in 2003-04, the first Wake Forest player to win consecutive tournaments since Haas in 2002-03, the first Deacon freshman to win consecutive tournaments since Curtis Strange in 1973-74, and the first Deacon to have two victories as a freshman since Gary Hallberg in 1976-77 ... ACC Player of the Month (October-November) ... Also was low Deac at the Schenkel Invitational where he posted a top-five finish (12-under, T-3rd) ... reached the round of 32 of the 2016 U.S. Amateur Four-Ball with Paul McBride ... reached the round of 16 of the 2016 U.S. Amateur. Prior to Wake Forest: Member of both the 2014 Junior Ryder Cup team and Junior World Cup team ... At the Junior Ryder Cup, helped Team USA win by a 16-8 margin ... Finished fourth at the Junior World Cup in Japan ... Also finished sixth at the Junior PGA Championship in 2014 ...Defeated some of the best juniors in the country to win the AJGA Polo Golf Junior Classic at PGA National in Palm Beach Gardens, Fla. ... Also won the Met Junior and tied for fifth at the Met Open. 2014 U.S. Amateur quarterfinalist and reached the match play of the event in 2015.
